# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package @angular/animations ### Is this a regression? No, not a regression. ### Description There is no way to determine if there is running animation at given moment after first call to `AnimationPlayer` `play` method. I am building `AnimationPlayer` in order to animate a given part of my application. Before I call `player.play()` method if I check `player.hasStarted()` it returns `false` which is ok. After first call to `player.play()` `player.hasStarted()` returns `true` when: - I check immediately after `player.play()` call - this is ok. - I check in `onDone` handler - not sure if this is ok. Player has started but it is also has ended. - I check after animation is done and I call `player.reset()` - this is not ok. I am resetting the player and I expect everything to be set to its initial value. Whatever I do `hasStarted` returns `true` after first call to `play`. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction Reproducing sample at this repository - https://github.com/wnvko/AngularAnimationsIssue Steps: - clone, `npm i` and then `ng serve -o`. - click on the button. - click again on the button. Observe how `hasStarted` changes. ## 🔥 Exception or Error No exception or errors are thrown. Just behavior is not correct. ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:**

OS: win32 x64

body: Hello, this has gotten so old that people are opening duplicate issues (#40472). Any chance it could get fixed? 😅
@0biWanKenobi - @matsko left the team and we don't currently have anyone focussed on animations bugs. If you have any ideas how it might be fixed, that might help to progress a resolution.
@petebacondarwin @0biWanKenobi I am looking into this. I have solution for this. Just verifying some scenarios.

Right now I will fix hasStarted() to return false in case of reset.
In case of onDone it is arguable and that decision will take time.
Also not sure right now how many  projects already using it and it will break things for them.

Still if stack holder decides that's it's valid case and they want to cover that as well in this ticket, then I will do it.
